visualCharacteristics: Two-column article header: large cover image on the left; breadcrumbs, heading, author byline and date/read-time on the right. Sits on a white section.
contentPattern: Row 1 (left): cover image. Row 1 (right): breadcrumb links + heading + author/date text.
usage: Use as an article or case-study header pairing a cover image with title and byline metadata.
